_doc.profile_specs: physical / native-format fields applied to the parametric profiles built from Tools/data/profiles. native_sensor_mm = sensor the grids were shot on; image_circle_mm = data-sheet coverage (hard black beyond it); pupil_visible_at_image_circle = fraction of the entrance pupil still unclipped at the image-circle edge wide open (sets the effective barrel length; 0.5 = one stop of corner falloff, typical for S35 primes)
_doc.projection_profiles: ideal fisheye lenses from their projection maths and data sheets (no measured grid needed)
_doc.presets: looks: profile + amount/breathing/out_of_range/wide_boost + image_circle + vignette (Physical: cos^4 + barrel clipping; Manual: curves) + bokeh (Physical: blades/barrel from specs; Manual). Petzval swirl is always manual (0 for modern primes).
_doc.note: imported by Content/Python/dynamiclens_tools.import_all(); every non-data-sheet number is flagged 'assumed' in its source string

ARRI_Master.label: ARRI / Zeiss Master Prime (spherical, T1.3)
ARRI_Master.source: Distortion: Andy Davis (Imagery for Media) Lens Files, grids shot on ALEXA SXT 2.8K (12-35 mm) and ALEXA Mini Open Gate (40-150 mm), solved in 3DE. Data sheet: 114 mm front, T1.3, 9-blade iris. Image circle 33.6 mm = the Mini Open Gate diagonal the grids cover (ARRI lists Master Primes as Super 35). Pupil visibility 0.5 at the circle edge: assumed (one stop corner falloff wide open).

ZEISS_Supreme.label: Zeiss Supreme Prime (spherical, T1.5, full frame)
ZEISS_Supreme.source: Distortion: Andy Davis (Imagery for Media) Lens Files, grids shot on ALEXA LF Open Gate, solved in 3DE. Data sheet: 95 mm front, T1.5, image circle 46.3 mm. Blade count 16 from Andy Davis's camera preset ini (Zeiss quotes a rounded iris). Pupil visibility 0.5: assumed.

Nikkor_6mm_Fisheye.label: Nikon Fisheye-Nikkor 6mm f/2.8 (220° circular)
Nikkor_6mm_Fisheye.source: Nikon data sheet: 220° angle of view, 23 mm image circle on 35 mm, 236 mm front diameter, f/2.8. Equidistant projection (Nikon fisheye family). Reported as the 6mm fisheye of The Favourite (Robbie Ryan, 35 mm 3-perf, Nikkor + Panavision PVintage). Unreal can render ~80° off-axis, so the outer ring of the circle is black. Blades and pupil visibility: assumed.

Nikkor_8mm_Fisheye.label: Nikon Fisheye-Nikkor 8mm f/2.8 (180° circular)
Nikkor_8mm_Fisheye.source: Nikon data sheet: 180° circular fisheye, 23 mm image circle, f/2.8, 123 mm front. Equidistant projection. An 8mm fisheye is reported for Poor Things' lab scenes. Blades and pupil visibility: assumed.

Nikkor_OP_10mm_Fisheye.label: Nikon OP Fisheye-Nikkor 10mm f/5.6 (180° orthographic, full frame)
Nikkor_OP_10mm_Fisheye.source: Nikon data sheet: orthographic projection (r = f sin theta), 180° across the diagonal of 24x36 (image circle ~44 mm), f/5.6. Candidate model for the '10mm' Ryan used for most of The Favourite: the exact 10mm is not named in interviews (Nikkor + Panavision PVintage sets were on the picture), so this is a reconstruction. Blades and pupil visibility: assumed.

Optex_4mm_S16_Fisheye.label: OpTex 4mm T2 fisheye for Super 16 (Poor Things porthole)
Optex_4mm_S16_Fisheye.source: Robbie Ryan (Poor Things): a PL-mount OpTex 4mm fisheye made for 16mm/S16 (opens to T2) mounted on a 35mm ARRICAM, giving the vignetted 'porthole' frame. Image circle 14.5 mm = Super 16 coverage, so on a 24.9 x 18.7 mm frame most of the picture is black. Projection assumed equidistant. Front diameter, blades and pupil visibility: assumed.

Master.label: ARRI/Zeiss Master Prime, as measured. Physical vignette and cat's eye, no swirl.

Supreme.label: Zeiss Supreme Prime, as measured. Physical vignette and cat's eye, no swirl.

MasterHeavy.label: Master Prime x1.6 with extra barrel under 24 mm and strong breathing. Extrapolates below 12 mm; corners go black past the overscan limit.

Subtle.label: Supreme x0.5, no breathing, light vignette, clean modern look.

Vintage.label: Master profile with a mild Petzval swirl, stronger cat's eye and vignette.

Lanthimos_Favourite_6mm.label: The Favourite fisheye: Nikkor 6mm 220° equidistant on 35 mm. Circular image, black corners, heavy natural falloff.

Lanthimos_Favourite_10mm.label: The Favourite ultra-wide: Nikkor OP 10mm orthographic fisheye reconstruction. Whole frame covered, strong edge compression.

PoorThings_Porthole_4mm.label: Poor Things porthole: OpTex 4mm Super 16 fisheye on a 35 mm frame. Small circular image, everything else black.

PoorThings_Lab_8mm.label: Poor Things lab: Nikkor 8mm 180° circular fisheye on 35 mm.

PoorThings_Petzval.label: Poor Things Petzval: Lomography Petzval 58/85 (TLS rehoused) swirl on a spherical prime. Strong sagittal swirl wide open, gone by f/4.
